info.name: Duong Lam - Banking API (MongoDB + JWT)
info.description:
FastAPI + MongoDB Atlas banking API.

Run it: start the server (python -m uvicorn main:app --reload), then right-click the collection > Run collection. Requests run top to bottom; ids are saved in collection variables, so run the whole collection, not single requests out of order.

Folder 0 logs in as admin and saves the JWT in {{token}}. The collection's Authorization tab sends "Bearer {{token}}" on every request; requests that test other users override it.

Folder 6 deletes what the run created (customers and accounts). Audit records are kept on purpose.

exec: pm.test("Says Not logged in", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Not logged in"));
pm.test("No password hash in the response", () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(r)).to.not.include("assword"));

request.description: Every later request sends Authorization: Bearer {{token}} (set on the collection's Authorization tab).

exec: pm.test("Linked to a new customer record", () => pm.expect(r.user.customerId).to.be.a("number"));
pm.test("Says Customer not found", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Customer not found"));
pm.test("List includes the new account", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(a => a.id)).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("accountId"))));
pm.test("All belong to this customer", () => list.forEach(a => pm.expect(a.customerId).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("customerId")))));
pm.test("3 records, newest first", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(t => t.type)).to.eql(["TRANSFER", "WITHDRAW", "DEPOSIT"]));
